an5.27:1.1: “Bhikkhus, being alert and mindful, develop concentration that is measureless.
an5.27:1.2: When, alert and mindful, you develop concentration that is measureless, five kinds of knowledge arise that are personally yours. What five? (1) The knowledge arises that is personally yours:
an5.27:1.4: ‘This concentration is presently pleasant and in the future has a pleasant result.’
an5.27:1.5: (2) The knowledge arises that is personally yours: ‘This concentration is noble and spiritual.’
an5.27:1.6: (3) The knowledge arises that is personally yours: ‘This concentration is not practiced by low persons.’ (4) The knowledge arises that is personally yours:
an5.27:1.7: ‘This concentration is peaceful and sublime, gained by full tranquilization, and attained to unification; it is not reined in and checked by forcefully suppressing the defilements.’
an5.27:1.8: (5) The knowledge arises that is personally yours: ‘I enter this concentration mindfully and I emerge from it mindfully.’
an5.27:2.1: Bhikkhus, being alert and continuously mindful, develop concentration that is measureless.
an5.27:2.2: When you are alert and mindful, developing concentration that is measureless, these five kinds of knowledge arise that are personally yours.”
